prompt: Compose one complete original 30-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: bright retro-futuristic synth groove with a compact melodic hook. Instruments: analog synth arpeggios, gated snare, synth bass, kick. Tempo 128 BPM. Distinct motif: two staccato notes and an octave leap. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 25-second reveal film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:28, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic electronic track featuring a driving synth bassline, punchy drums, and bright, arpeggiated synth melodies. It has a modern, slightly retro feel, suitable for promotional content or background music.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和动感的电子音乐，以强劲的合成器贝斯线、有力的鼓点和明亮、琶音的合成器旋律为特色。它具有现代感，略带复古风，适合宣传内容或背景音乐。
